items.html: And there we explained the reason in this: how it was emanated from the aspect of the wool of the upper lamb, which is the Daat of the upper beard, where is the lower beard in Yesod, the sign of the holy covenant of Arich Anpin. And this is the secret in Idra de Nasso, page 139b: that the verse "From the straits I called upon Yah," etc., is said of the beard of ZA, called Meitzar, because it is drawn from the upper wool.
